final_reply:
We logged **32 calls** with Oceanic Shipping in the last 180 days (from 2026-04-24 to today, 2026-10-21).

- **30** are weekly sync calls logged on the account, from 2026-04-27 to 2026-10-18.
- **2** are logged on deals:
  - "Oceanic Shipping - Port Integration" (2026-10-16)
  - "Oceanic Shipping - Fleet Expansion" (2026-10-17)

All 32 calls are marked Completed, and all were with Kate Austen. I checked activities on the account, its three deals and both contacts, then searched all tasks for "Oceanic" to catch any that weren't linked. Both searches returned the same 32 calls. I counted only tasks whose subject starts with "Call:", and the weekly sync from 2026-04-21 falls just outside the window. Nothing was changed.

ANSWER: 32
